column3: Applicant must complete and sign the official affiliation/filiación form.
Letter in Spanish must state purpose, applicant identity, nationality, age, occupation, Costa Rica address, and notification method.
Applicant must provide passport identity pages and maintain valid passport/travel document.
Applicant must provide criminal background certificate from country of origin or where legally resident.
Applicant must provide birth certificate.
Applicant must provide recent passport-size photographs.
Applicant must pay required DGME government fees and fiscal stamps.
Foreign documents must be legalized or apostilled; documents not in Spanish require official translation.
